assumptions.snr: Training-average whitened receive SNR per complex measurement, calibrated by pilot power; not per-scene or accumulated pilot SNR.
assumptions.budget: Increasing J increases pilot duration and energy; this is not a fixed-total-energy comparison.
assumptions.covariance: 512 independent training geometries fixed for all J and SNR; joint sample LMMSE is not an oracle population-covariance baseline.
assumptions.propagation: Same declared physical model as physical_baselines_20261021_v2: assumed refractive index 1.5 and receiver noise figure 6 dB; absorption-table atmospheric metadata unknown.
assumptions.architecture: Implementation-only 2 x 4 planar DMA; not the full-size experiment.
assumptions.geometry: Planar x-z array; all direct and reflector points have fixed known elevation 30 degrees and random azimuth/range. No mutual coupling.
assumptions.ddpm: Implementation-only short training and two draws; not the formal DDPM budget.
